evidence_items.section: # Calvin > ## Boston trip (planned as of 2023-04-20; Frank Ocean tour stop as of 2023-05-31; personal visit July 2023)
evidence_items.text:
- As of 2023-05-31, the Boston visit is part of the Frank Ocean tour: "Cool, can't wait for the tour with Frank!" — he's "buzzing to perform in Boston and see what it's like" and "Gonna be great playing for folks from home" (calling Boston's folks "from home" suggests it is where he's from, though not stated outright). He asked Dave what he thinks of the music scene there; Dave: it's "awesome — Tons of talented musicians and cool places to play," and he'll be there to cheer Calvin on (details in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S7T15][S7T16].
- On 2023-06-09, said he has never been to Boston before but has heard the parks are amazing — "can't wait to visit next month" (i.e., July 2023); he wants to take walks in the Boston parks to experience their serenity and recharge, and asked Dave what cool things he remembers about them; shared a photo of a tree with pink flowers (likely from the album session); Dave's recollections of the Boston parks are in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston [S8T5][S8T7].
- As of 2023-08-22, said his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, and proposed meeting up with Dave then — "Maybe we can meet up then!" (renewing the earlier plan to meet in Boston, see above); Dave: "Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" (Note: the 2023-08-14 update described the Frank Ocean tour as already having ended with the Tokyo show, so this "tour ends soon" may be a continuation or a new tour — unconfirmed) [S15T10][S15T11].
- On 2023-09-02, told Dave he booked a flight to Boston "last week" (~2023-08-26 through 09-01) and is "so excited" about the upcoming Boston trip, sharing a photo of a book with a boarding pass on it — "See you soon, buddy!"; he'll let Dave know when he's in Boston, and Dave told him to let him know when he's free so they can catch up in Boston (continuing the plan to meet up in Boston, see above) [S17T6][S17T7][S17T8]. The chat closed with Dave: "Looking forward to seeing you! Have a safe trip, see ya!"; Calvin thanked Dave, reciprocated the safe-trip wishes ("Gotta stay safe on the trip"), said "Can't wait to see you there!", and promised he will contact Dave when he arrives [S17T9][S17T10].
- On 2023-09-13, re-pledged the plan to let Dave know when he's in Boston — "I'll let you know when I'm in Boston" — and accepted Dave's offer to check out his garage and its cool cars (Dave shared a photo of the garage — a car in a garage with a Coca-Cola sign — "looks stunning!"), saying it would be fun and might give him ideas for future projects (details in ## Relationships; Dave's side in /memories/dave.md > ## Boston) [S18T11][S18T12].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- On 2023-08-14, when Dave asked for pictures from the show, shared a photo from the tour's closing show in Tokyo (details in ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)): a crowd of people at the concert with their hands up — "It was so awesome - I loved how the crowd was into it. These moments are why I love my job." [S14T8].
- On 2023-08-14, said the tour's closing show was "buzzing" — "It's moments like these that make me so proud and motivated" — and that he's "all about spreading joy with my art" [S14T10].
- As of 2023-08-22, scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean and recorded a song in the studio at his mansion (details in ## Frank Ocean collaboration) [S15T2][S15T4].
- On 2023-08-22, when Dave asked if any other collaborations came out of the performance, said someone noticed his performance and now they're working together — "which is wild"; the collaborator's identity is not specified (a new collaborator besides Frank Ocean, or Frank Ocean himself — unconfirmed) [S15T10].
- On 2023-08-31 (octopus-guitar chat, see ## Octopus guitar), after Dave said his unique style really stands out in his music and playing, Calvin said he's glad Dave appreciates it: trying to stay true to himself and be unique in his music is something he values [S16T24].

evidence_items.speaker: Calvin
evidence_items.text:
- As of 2023-08-22, scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean — "a dream come true"; "I've been working hard and it's finally paying off", and "no words can describe how happy I am" [S15T2].
- How it came about: he met Frank Ocean at a music festival in Tokyo and they clicked; they've been speaking and sharing ideas, arranged a meeting, and Calvin recorded a song in the studio at his mansion (the mansion he is turning into a recording studio, see ## Recording studio (2023-07-21)) — "it's been great!" [S15T4]. (This may be the Tokyo music festival he attended on 2023-04-20 — see ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20) — but that is not confirmed.)
- On that festival: the city was "buzzing with energy" and the festival crowd was "so lively" — "it was like fuel for my soul"; he called the experience "a dream come true" — "The festival had buzzing energy and a super upbeat crowd. We all felt connected, it was amazing!"; shared a photo of the crowd (people sitting on the grass at night) [S15T6][S15T8].
- How it started — Calvin's account on 2023-10-19: "It all started August last year" (i.e., August 2022) when he and Frank Ocean met at a festival and Frank said he wanted to collaborate — "We clicked right away and the chemistry on stage was incredible. I'm so lucky!" This is a later, more specific account than the 2023-08-22 one (a Tokyo music festival, possibly the one he attended on 2023-04-20 — see ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20)); the two accounts differ on when/where they met (August 2022 festival vs. a 2023 Tokyo festival) — both kept. [S24T5]

- The 2023-08-14 conversation continued: Calvin asked how Dave's car restoration project was going; Dave said it's "going great" and shared a photo of the car (a car with a broken engine in the woods) (details in /memories/dave.md, Car mod workshop section); Calvin predicted the car "is going to look amazing when you're done" and asked how long the restore would take, and Calvin said it was "buzzing" to see the crowd — "It's moments like these that make me so proud and motivated" [S14T10][S14T11][S14T12].
- The 2023-08-14 conversation closed with Calvin cheering Dave on: "You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you. Seeing your enthusiasm is amazing. Keep growing, buddy. It'll be worth it! Good luck with that. See ya!" [S14T16].
- On 2023-08-22, reconnected with Dave ("Haven't talked in a while!"): Dave shared that he'd had a card night with friends; Calvin told Dave he scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean (details in ## Frank Ocean collaboration) — Dave: "Wow Calvin, congrats! Super excited for you." and asked how the chance came up; Calvin explained he met Frank at a Tokyo music festival, they clicked, and they recorded a song in his mansion studio; Dave: "Wow, Tokyo sounds like an incredible experience!" and asked what it was like playing at the festival; Calvin described the buzzing energy, the lively crowd, and feeling connected with everyone, and shared a photo of the crowd on the grass [S15T1][S15T2][S15T3][S15T4][S15T5][S15T6][S15T7][S15T8] (Dave's card-night details in /memories/dave.md > ## Card night (2023-08-18))
- The 2023-08-22 conversation continued: Dave asked whether any other collaborations came out of the performance and about upcoming concerts; Calvin: "Yeah Dave, someone even noticed my performance and now we're working together, which is wild. My tour ends soon and I'm heading to Boston. Maybe we can meet up then!" (collaborator and tour details in ## Music and ## Boston trip); Dave agreed to meet up when Calvin is in Boston and asked for the details when he has them; Calvin then almost-reminded himself and told Dave that on 2023-08-21 he and his friends recorded a podcast about the rap industry (details in ## Podcast (2023-08-21)); Dave said he was looking forward to listening and to learning more about the rap industry, "Keep up the great work!"; Calvin said he'd let Dave know when the podcast will be uploaded, "Take care!"; Dave: "Sure, Calvin! Looking forward to hearing about it. See ya then!" [S15T9][S15T10][S15T11][S15T12][S15T13][S15T14][S15T15].
- On 2023-08-31, reconnected with Dave ("Long time no chat!"): Dave asked how the end of the tour was ("I bet it was amazing!"), and Calvin said the tour was amazing — he was "so pumped from all the energy from the audience" — sharing a photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen ("This pic totally captures how I felt. Such an amazing time!"); Dave asked how it was performing on that big stage, and Calvin said it was "a dream come true", he "felt on top of the world", and it was "seriously surreal"; Dave: "Wow, that must have been an incredible experience! Congrats on achieving such an awesome moment!"; Calvin then said he'd started shooting a video for his new album the weekend before (~2023-08-25/26) — "can't wait for you to check it out!" — and shared a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach ("Look how great it was!"); Dave: "Can't wait to see it", and asked whether it will be shot on location; Calvin: the shoot is in Miami, on an awesome beach — "It's going to have some epic visuals!" (details in ## Tokyo trip (2023-04-20) and ## Music video (Miami, 2023-08-31)) [S16T1][S16T2][S16T3][S16T4][S16T5][S16T6][S16T7][S16T8].

- The 2023-08-14 conversation continued: Dave told Calvin the car restoration is "going great" and shared a photo of it (details in ## Car mod workshop (2023-08-11)); Calvin predicted it "is going to look amazing when you're done" and asked how long it would take. Dave said Calvin's support "means a lot to [him]" [S14T11][S14T12][S14T13][S14T15].
- The 2023-08-14 conversation closed with Calvin cheering Dave on — "You got this, Dave! I'm always here for you. Seeing your enthusiasm is amazing. Keep growing, buddy. It'll be worth it! Good luck with that. See ya!" — after Calvin said Dave "has some serious talent" and he was "really excited to see the end result of [Dave's] hard work" [S14T14][S14T16].
- On 2023-08-22, reconnected with Calvin ("Haven't talked in a while!"): Dave shared that he'd had a card night with friends on 2023-08-18 (details in ## Card night (2023-08-18)); Calvin told him he scored a deal to continue collaborating with Frank Ocean — "a dream come true" — and Dave: "Wow Calvin, congrats! Super excited for you." and asked how the chance came up; Calvin explained that he met Frank at a music festival in Tokyo, they clicked, and they recorded a song in Calvin's mansion studio; Dave: "Wow, Tokyo sounds like an incredible experience!" and asked what it was like playing at the festival; Calvin described the buzzing energy, the lively crowd, and "We all felt connected, it was amazing!", sharing a photo of the crowd sitting on the grass at night (Calvin's side in the Frank Ocean collaboration section of /memories/calvin.md) [S15T1][S15T2][S15T3][S15T4][S15T5][S15T6][S15T7][S15T8].
- The 2023-08-22 conversation continued: Dave asked if any other collaborations came out of that performance and about any upcoming concerts; Calvin said someone noticed his performance and now they're working together — "which is wild" — and that his tour ends soon and he's heading to Boston, proposing they meet up (details in the Boston trip section of /memories/calvin.md); Dave: "Sounds great! Fill me in on the details when you have them and let's meet up when you're here. Can't wait to hear all about everything!" Calvin added that on 2023-08-21 ("yesterday" as of 2023-08-22) he and his friends recorded a podcast where they discuss the rapidly evolving rap industry; Dave: "That sounds fantastic! I'm looking forward to listening to your podcast and learning more about the rap industry. Keep up the great work!"; Calvin said he'd let Dave know when the podcast will be uploaded, "Take care!"; Dave: "Sure, Calvin! Looking forward to hearing about it. See ya then!" [S15T9][S15T10][S15T11][S15T12][S15T13][S15T14][S15T15].
- On 2023-08-31, reconnected with Calvin ("Long time no chat!"): Dave asked how the end of the tour was ("I bet it was amazing!"), and Calvin said the tour was amazing — "so pumped from all the energy from the audience" — sharing a photo of a crowd watching a concert with a large screen; Dave: "Wow, that looks amazing!" and asked how it was performing on that big stage; Calvin: "a dream come true", "on top of the world", "seriously surreal"; Dave: "Wow, that must have been an incredible experience! Congrats on achieving such an awesome moment!"; Calvin said he'd started shooting a video for his new album the weekend before (~2023-08-25/26), sharing a photo of a camera and a video camera on a beach; Dave: "Can't wait to see it", and asked "Will it be shot on location?"; Calvin: the shoot is in Miami, on an awesome beach — "It's going to have some epic visuals!"; the conversation continued with Dave saying the Miami beaches are awesome and that he can't wait to see them, and Calvin saying he loves the Miami vibe, it's "perfect for the vid", and "can't wait to show you!"; Dave was excited to see the vibe and location and offered to help with props or anything else for the video ("I'm here to support you!" / "let me know when, I'm here to lend a hand. It's great to fuel your ideas."); Calvin thanked him, said he'll let Dave know if he needs any assistance with props or anything else, and "Your support is much appreciated." The chat then turned to the photo Dave had sent once of Calvin's custom guitar with an octopus on it — Dave: "Love how this guitar shows our different artistic styles." — and Calvin explained he had it custom made by his Japanese artist friend, that the octopus represents his love for art and the sea, and that it's one of his favorites; Dave: "That's a great guitar, Calvin! Love the design, it's so unique and special.", and Calvin: "Cheers, mate! Really appreciate it. This guitar means so much to me; it's a reminder of my passion for music and the amazing friendships I've made."; Dave: "Wow, Calvin, this instrument obviously means a lot to you - it's like a representation of your journey, your passion for music, and the friendships you've made. Amazing!"; Calvin: "It's like every mark and strum holds a story", sharing a photo of the guitar with a purple glow; Dave marveled at the "gorgeous purple hue" and asked why it is so shiny, and Calvin said he had it customized with a shiny finish because it gives it a unique look and goes with his style; Dave: "Good pick!" and "Looks great on you! Your unique style really stands out in your music and playing."; Calvin: "Thanks, dude! I dig how it's so unique. It's totally my style!", and said that staying true to himself and being unique in his music is something he values, so it's great that Dave appreciates it; Dave then affirmed — "Definitely, staying true to yourself and your style is vital. It makes you unique and your music stand out. Keep it real, bud. You've got something great to give the world." — and re-shared, in that message, a photo of a man working on a car engine in a garage (matches the photo of his shop work he shared on 2023-05-03 — see ## Car maintenance shop) (Calvin's side in the Music video and Octopus guitar sections of /memories/calvin.md) [S16T1][S16T2][S16T3][S16T4][S16T5][S16T6][S16T7][S16T8][S16T9][S16T10][S16T11][S16T12][S16T13][S16T14][S16T15][S16T16][S16T17][S16T18][S16T19][S16T20][S16T21][S16T22][S16T23][S16T24][S16T25].
